# Test data for internal/webmap

Fetched once on 2026-09-25 with the user agent
`playkeeper-fixtures (https://github.com/CIYAhq/playkeeper)`, then trimmed.
Tests never touch the network.

## Add-on identifiers

- `modrinth-project-squaremap.json`: `GET https://api.modrinth.com/v2/project/squaremap`,
  keeping `id`, `slug`, `title`, `project_type`, `license`, `loaders` and
  `game_versions`.
- `hangar-project-squaremap.json`: the project record for `jmp/squaremap`
  from Hangar's API (`https://hangar.papermc.io/api/v1/projects/…`), keeping
  `id`, `name`, `namespace`, `settings.license` and `supportedPlatforms`.

## squaremap's web answers (`squaremap/`)

From the public squaremap demo map (`https://squaremap-demo.jpenilla.xyz/`,
linked from squaremap's Modrinth page). The demo is a static export (its
settings say `"static": true`) that still uses squaremap's older world
names. Adapted to what squaremap (commit ac71dd2f, 2026-09-16) serves from
its internal web server, as its `UpdateWorldData` and `UpdatePlayers` tasks
write it:

- `settings.json` (`/tiles/settings.json`): the demo's list, with world names
  changed from the old `world`, `world_nether`, `world_the_end` to today's
  dimension-id names (`minecraft_overworld`, …), display names set to
  squaremap's default (`{world}`, the dimension id), the demo's
  `terralith_overworld` typed `custom` as squaremap now types every
  non-vanilla dimension, and the static export's `"static": true` removed.
  The `ui` part, which holds HTML, is kept as served.
- `minecraft_overworld-settings.json`, `minecraft_the_nether-settings.json`,
  `minecraft_the_end-settings.json` (`/tiles/<world>/settings.json`): the
  demo's `world`, `world_nether` and `world_the_end` settings, unchanged.
  `terralith_overworld-settings.json` is the overworld's with spawn at 0, 0.
- `players.json` (`/tiles/players.json`): the demo's two players (Notch and
  pewdiepie_epic) with their world renamed, `yaw` rounded and `y` added as
  squaremap now writes them. Added: Dinnerbone and jeb_ (public Mojang
  accounts), a fictional End player, a fictional Bedrock player behind
  Floodgate (dot-prefixed name, Floodgate-style UUID), and an HTML
  `display_name` like squaremap writes when `use-display-names` is on.
- `resume_render.json` (`data/<world>/resume_render.json` in squaremap's
  folder): written by hand in the format of squaremap's `RenderManager`
  (Gson with complex map keys: region coordinates and whether each is drawn),
  5 of 12 regions drawn.
- `spa-fallback.html`: what the demo's web host answers, with status 200 and
  `text/html`, for a path it does not have. Used as a wrong-type answer.

Tiles are generated by the tests with `image/png`.

## Golden files

`config-default.yml` and `config-shared.yml` are what `Config` writes; run
`go test ./internal/webmap -run TestConfigGolden -update` to rewrite them
after a deliberate change, and review the diff.
